title: Students extend support to protesting ASHA workers

ai.summary: Students in Belagavi joined a statewide protest supporting ASHA workers demanding ₹15,000 monthly honorarium from Karnataka government, as the workers have been protesting for 12 days at Freedom Park since November 17.

facts.claim: Students of Government Sardar Pre-University College in Belagavi expressed solidarity with ASHA workers protesting in Bengaluru
facts.quote: Students of Government Sardar Pre-University College in Belagavi expressed solidarity with ASHA workers protesting in Bengaluru on Saturday, in an event held as part of a State-wide ‘Demand Day’ organised by the All India Democratic Students’ Organisation (AIDSO).

facts.claim: The protest has been ongoing for 12 days
facts.quote: The protest had entered its 12th day, with the workers continuing their agitation despite the cold and rain, he said.

facts.claim: ASHA workers demand ₹15,000 monthly honorarium from Karnataka government
facts.quote: demanding a monthly honorarium of ₹15,000 from the State government

ai.background_note: ASHA workers in Karnataka have been protesting since November 17 for a monthly honorarium of ₹15,000, with students joining the movement to support their demands.
